 Judgment

Dated this the 08th day of January, 2025 This L.A.A. has been filed challenging the judgment and decree dated 11.06.2014 in L.A.R. No.33 of 2012 of the II Additional Subordinate Judge,
Thiruvanathapuram.

The appellant was the claimant in the said L.A.R.
2.
An extent of 0.19 ares of land comprised in Sy.No.1170/9 of Pattom Village had been acquired for widening of Pattom - Medical College - Kochulloor Road.
Notification under Section 4 (1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 had been published on 12.11.2008.
The Land Acquisition Officer had fixed the land value at Rs.3,29,641/- per are.
The appellant, dissatisfied with the same, filed the reference seeking enhancement @ Rs.50,00,000/- per cent.

3. Heard Sri.B.Ananthu, learned counsel appearing for the appellant and Smt.Rekha C.Nair, learned Senior Government Pleader who appeared for the respondents.
4.

It is brought to my notice that L.A.A.No.127 of 2015 2025:KER:734 concerning the same purpose of acquisition viz., for Pattom - Medical College - Kochulloor Road under the same notification published on 12.11.2008 had been disposed of by this Court vide judgment dated 10.12.2018.

In the said L.A.A., this Court had enhanced the compensation by refixing the land value at Rs.41,63,940/-
per Are.
The said judgment in turn was rendered following the judgment in L.A.A.No.84 of 2016.

It is submitted by the learned counsel appearing for the appellant that since the land covered under the appeal at hand is also identically situated, the enhancement and re-fixation ought to be on similar lines.

5. It is noted that the appellant in the L.A.A. at hand has limited the amount claimed in this appeal to Rs.33,83,940/- per Are for 0.19 Ares, i.e., to Rs.6,42,948/-.
6.
There is no dispute with regard to the fact that the land involved in L.A.A. No.84 of 2016 and the land involved in the present case are of the same nature and that they are similarly situated.

Taking note of the fact that this court had vide judgment dated 10.12.2018 in L.A.A.No.127 of 2015 granted an amount of Rs.41,63,940/- per are, and since the appellant has limited the claim 2025:KER:734 to the lesser sum of Rs.6,42,948/- for 0.19 ares, it is fit and proper that this L.A.A. can be allowed as prayed for.
In view of the above, this L.A.A. is allowed.

The land value of the acquired lands in L.A.R.No.33 of 2012 of the II Additional Subordinate Judge, Thiruvanathapuram, is enhanced and refixed at Rs.33,83,940/- per Are for 0.19 Ares, i.e., to Rs.6,42,948/-.
(Rupees Six Lakhs Forty Two Thousand Nine hundred and Forty Eight only).
The appellants will be entitled to admissible statutory benefits in accordance with the law.
